summary.text: Bill Roemer is a member of the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 31, which includes northern and western portions of Summit County. His official biography says he is serving his fourth term and chairs the Ways and Means Committee in the 136th General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: The House biography says Roemer holds a bachelor of science in accounting, summa cum laude, and an MBA from the Weatherhead School of Management, both at Case Western Reserve University.
It describes him as a retired AT&T sales director and a Certified Public Accountant who previously worked in regulatory accounting, and a former instructor of finance at Myers University.

The biography says Roemer served on Summit County Council and as vice president of the Summit Educational Service Center Board of Governors, and has worked for 16 years as a substitute teacher in the Revere School District.
It says he volunteered with Revere Baseball for 27 years and that his family has owned a farm in Summit County for over 80 years.
It says he is married to Josie Roemer and lives in Richfield.
